name: 92405 · Sn Bernrdno, CA
findings: ZIP 92405 (Sn Bernrdno) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92405 (Sn Bernrdno) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
